fields.description: First word of the 25-byte profile block at save offset 0xE0. Cleared to zero by the save-default routine next to FUN_080011a4 and loaded/saved as the head of the 0x19-byte unit in FUN_08001474 / FUN_080014a0; reads as a career/play counter.
fields.evidence: FUN_080011a4 zeroes 4 bytes then sets 21 bytes to 1 (matches sav 0xE0..0xF8: 4x00 + 21x01); FUN_08001474 and FUN_080014a0 load/save this 0x19-byte unit with func_0x0802c130 / func_0x0802c194 from SRAM.
fields.name: career_counter

fields.description: 21 per-event/per-item progress flags, all set (0x01) in the live baseline. Defaulted to 1 by the init routine next to FUN_080011a4 and persisted as the tail of the 0x19-byte unit.
fields.evidence: Init code next to FUN_080011a4 writes 1 to 21 consecutive bytes (sav 0xE4..0xF8 reads 21x01); FUN_08001474 / FUN_080014a0 persist the whole 0x19-byte unit via SRAM helpers func_0x0802c130 / func_0x0802c194.
fields.name: unlock_progress_flags
